brief:
Yusuke Furusawa, a prominent pro-Palestine activist from Japan, discussed his ongoing demonstrations against Israel's military operations in Gaza with Al Jazeera English. Furusawa described his commitment to continued protest action against what he characterizes as a genocidal war.

The activist's remarks reflected the global reach of solidarity movements over the Gaza conflict, with demonstrations taking place across East Asia alongside those in the Middle East and beyond.
dek: Japanese activist Yusuke Furusawa speaks to Al Jazeera about why he keeps protesting Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
title: Japanese activist Furusawa speaks out on Gaza protests
